summary: Oil-Dri Corporation of America filed a Form 8-K on October 8, 2026, covering Item 2.02 results of operations for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended July 31, 2026, plus Item 8.01 other events. The board, meeting October 7, 2026, appointed Anthony W. Parker, Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary, as an executive officer and declared quarterly cash dividends of $0.225 per common share and $0.168 per Class B share, payable November 20, 2026 to holders of record November 6, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend current report, not a special situation.
